facts.subject: (unnamed) expelled Burgers

ledger.summary: At Clement's house Ralph hears from a bold carle who mingled with the foe that the Burgers entered Upmeads at noon and skirmished with Nicholas at the High House without gain. They do not know of the Shepherds or the Dry Tree and await their Higham-land folk. They will not burn the High House or steadings, meaning to keep them for themselves. Ralph orders an early start and briefs all his leaders on the order of battle. Katherine, Ralph's gossip and foster-mother, greets him in tears. Ralph tells his journeys, then asks whether she has drunk of the Well (she looks young) and how she came by the beads. Clement says she has not drunk; such wise, valiant women wear well.
ledger.geography_notes: The Burgers entered Upmeads-land at noon and attacked the High House. The fighting men are quartered in Wulstead. Katherine's bower is upstairs in Clement's house.
